english_draft:
This is a reconstruction. It is not a contemporaneous forecast. It uses only the Samsung Electronics release of 30 April 2026.

Q1 2026 baseline:
Samsung Electronics reported Q1 2026 results on 30 April 2026.
Consolidated revenue was KRW 133.9 trillion. Revenue increased 43% QoQ. Revenue was an all-time quarterly high.
Consolidated operating profit was KRW 57.2 trillion. Operating profit was also an all-time quarterly high.
The DS Division reported revenue of KRW 81.7 trillion. DS operating profit was KRW 53.7 trillion.
The Memory Business set all-time quarterly records for revenue and operating profit.
MX and Networks reported revenue of KRW 38.1 trillion. MX and Networks operating profit was KRW 2.8 trillion.
SDC reported revenue of KRW 6.7 trillion. SDC operating profit was KRW 0.4 trillion.
VD and DA reported revenue of KRW 14.3 trillion. VD and DA operating profit was KRW 0.2 trillion.
Harman reported an earnings decline in Q1 2026.

Q2 2026 company guidance:
The Memory Business expects strong demand in Q2 2026. It plans to deliver the first HBM4E samples.
System LSI plans to increase SoC and sensor sales for volume-tier smartphones.
Foundry plans full utilization of advanced-node lines. It plans to increase HBM4 base-die supply.
MX expects QoQ revenue to decline in Q2 2026. MX expects YoY revenue growth.
SDC will focus on the high-end segment in small and medium displays.
VD will target revenue from sporting-event-driven demand.
DA expects a recovery in air-conditioner demand.
Harman expects earnings growth from increased automotive supply.

Core questions:
Can Memory sustain high profit after a record quarter?
Can MX keep single-digit profitability in a seasonally weak quarter?
Can non-memory businesses reduce the profit gap with DS?

Potential positive variances:
AI infrastructure demand could be stronger than expected.
Memory ASP could rise further.
Foundry utilization and HBM4 base-die supply could improve.
MX cost optimization could exceed expectations.

Potential negative variances:
Memory prices could fall as supply constraints ease.
HBM4E sample progress could be delayed.
MX could face higher costs and tariffs.
SDC small and medium display demand could remain weak.
Harman expenses could stay high.

Verification points:
DS revenue and operating profit.
Memory ASP and high-value-added product share.
MX revenue and operating margin.
Foundry utilization, HBM4E, DDR5, SOCAMM2, 2nm progress.
SDC premium share and 8.6G IT OLED.
VD, DA, Harman automotive supply and earnings.

Analysis:
No contemporaneous preview exists. The Q2 2026 actual results were not available at the cutoff. Therefore this reconstruction does not compare actual results.
reader_questions: 来源中“Q2 revenue is expected to decline”说的是MX Business还是MX+Networks整体？Q1基数是MX+Networks合并38.1万亿韩元，若把公司对MX业务的展望套到包含Networks的分部，会误判收入趋势。
“first HBM4E samples”是否意味着已开始贡献收入？来源用“scheduled to deliver”，若把送样等同量产，会高估DS的Q2利润弹性。
“industry-wide memory price increases”是外部价格环境还是公司产品竞争力？来源同时提到ASP上升和高附加值AI产品，若不区分两者，就无法判断存储利润的可持续性。
fact_checks: round1_date_quarter: 来源发布于2026-04-30，报告期为2026Q1（截至2026-03-31）；本稿用于2026Q2预览，截至cutoff未使用Q2财报后资料。
round1_currency_unit: 来源数字单位为万亿韩元；本稿沿用，未换算其他币种。
round1_scope: 133.9/57.2为三星电子合并口径；81.7/53.7为DS部门；38.1/2.8为MX与Networks；6.7/0.4为SDC；14.3/0.2为VD与DA；Harman无单独数字。
round1_gaap: 来源仅称operating profit；本稿译为营业利润，未在来源中标注GAAP/非GAAP，不另作定义。
round1_fact_vs_guidance: HBM4E首批样品、MX Q2环比降/同比升、Foundry满产、SDC高端、Harman汽车供应等为公司指引，不是已实现事实；本稿已标注。
round1_no_consensus_stock: 来源未提供市场共识或股价；本稿未编造或引用共识、股价。
round2_summary: 三个读者问题已用于复核；正文已区分MX+Networks合并口径与MX业务展望，避免把HBM4E送样等同收入，避免把存储ASP普涨与AI产品结构混为一谈。
